modulo() returns `a % (b - 1)` instead of `a % b`. For modulo(10, 3), this yields 10 % 2 = 0 instead of the expected 1.
Test asserts modulo(10, 3) == 1, but the implementation returns 10 % (3-1) = 10 % 2 = 0, causing the assertion to fail.
